purpose: Audit city-scoped land/cadastre evidence separately from accessible public parcel geometry; record only executed searches and actual page/request outcomes.
name: Praia
pointBasis: Chosen approximate central-city query point; not a WUP centroid or official boundary.
jurisdiction: Municipality of Praia, Santiago Island; INGT is Cabo Verde's national cadastre and territorial authority.
registryBasis: A 2024 official INGT notice starts the Santiago cadastral operation and explicitly includes Município da Praia, with declarations scheduled through November 2025; it also names Praia service locations. This establishes city-specific cadastral activity, not completion or open vector coverage. The live public portal exposes NIP-based cadastral lookup and cadastral-plan issuance workflows.
findings: City-specific registry activity is confirmed by the official 2024 Santiago cadastral-operation notice, which explicitly lists Praia. Fresh web.open inspection of the public portal showed NIP-based cadastral lookup and cadastral-plan issuance; clicking Planta Cadastral and Informação Cadastral redirected to a login screen. A fresh opened official ArcGIS REST FeatureServer lists administrative layers (ilha, concelho, freguesia, zona, cidade, vila, lugar, bairro_cidade, bairro_vila), not parcels. Direct WFS capabilities URLs were inaccessible through the web tool, with no HTTP status or server response. No anonymous public parcel geometry was verified; this is a scoped access finding, not evidence that the registry lacks parcel data.
